intro.tagline: Your favorite folders and files, opened instantly
intro.label: Windows 10 and 11 · free · open source

board.title: Your board, one shortcut away
board.body: Folders, files, web sites and Windows special folders, grouped in tabs, columns and colored groups.

add.title: Add where you are, in one click
add.body: The “Add” menu offers the page your browser shows (Firefox, Chrome, Edge) as “Current URL” and, from File Explorer or a file dialog, the “Current folder”.

edit.title: Arrange it your way
edit.body: Click “Edit”: add, rename and recolor tabs, columns, groups and items, and move them by drag and drop. Every change is saved at once.

icons.title: An icon for every group
icons.body: “Automatic” suggests an emoji from the name of the tab or group. Or pick the one you like by hand.

context.title: It knows where you called it from
context.body: Called from File Explorer or an Open / Save As dialog, a click on a folder takes that very window there. From a dialog, only folders are offered.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.body: Seven themes, Light, Dark or Auto mode (like Windows), nine languages, and export and import of the configuration.
